messages:
sara_marketing: Quick ask — we need a minimal repro pack + smoke test from runtime for the launch press claim. Timeline: press deck locked Weds EOD. Can you produce: 1) a tiny reproducible dataset (~20 payloads) covering short/long/edge cases, 2) a single-command warmup + exact run command we can copy, 3) quantized variant artifacts and a one-line delta summary vs FP, and 4) a brief provenance note (who ran it, when, model hash) that marketing can attach. Need by Tue noon. @jay_runtime @li_eng :pray:

jay_runtime: Ack — we can do that. Need to confirm a couple of things: which model name/tag (we have redwood-v2-7b, v2-13b, and quantized q4/q8 variants), target seq len for the press claim, and whether streaming was used in the demo.

sara_marketing: Target model for the claim is redwood-v2-7b (we plan to call q4 in the blurb). Demo uses streaming for UX but the benchmark numbers were non-streaming tokens. Use seq len 512 for the runpack.

li_eng: For the smoke pack: what sampling settings should we include? temperature/greedy/beam? Also confirm batch size you want us to lock in for numbers.

sara_marketing: Keep it deterministic for audit: greedy / temp 0, batch 1. We want latency-focused numbers.

jay_runtime: Got it. We'll produce: - smoke_payloads.json (20 payloads: 8 short, 8 medium, 4 long/edge) - run_smoke.sh with exact docker/command - smoke-report.txt with 50/95/99 latencies, token counts, and q4 vs fp deltas - README.md (provenance + how we warmed up).

jay_runtime: Quick command we'll include (copy-paste):

```bash
./run_smoke.sh --model redwood-v2-7b-q4 --payloads smoke_payloads.json \\n  --batch 1 --warmup 50 --seq 512 --streaming false --out artifacts/1887654321
```

li_eng: We'll annotate which payloads are "edge" and which are typical. Also will add the exact model git-hash and quantization recipe.

nina_product: For marketing copy, can you add a one-liner we can paste: e.g. "q4 quantized model showed <8% latency overhead vs FP and X% throughput gain" — please make that precise in the report so legal/press can rely on it.

jay_runtime: We'll include a precise line in smoke-report.txt. Expect numbers like: p95 latency (q4) = 120ms, p95 (fp) = 110ms -> +9% delta. We'll write exact measured numbers and include margin notes for variance across runs.

sara_marketing: Perfect — also please upload the smoke-pack tarball to the project bucket and drop the gs link here so we can attach it to the PR for press.

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/minirepro/1887654321/smoke-pack.tar.gz (files: smoke_payloads.json, run_smoke.sh, smoke-report.txt, README.md)

li_eng: Small ask — can marketing confirm that the payloads are okay to publish? Some contain paraphrased third-party content. If not, we'll swap to synthetic variants.

sara_marketing: Good catch — swap any third-party content to paraphrased or synthetic. Keep one explicit "real-world-like" long prompt but sanitized.

jay_runtime: Final: we've uploaded sanitized pack and included exact warmup instructions + a tiny CSV manifest (payload_id, intent, edge_flag). Link above is final.

sara_marketing: Amazing, thank you. We'll spot-check the run locally with the provided command and follow up if any numbers look off before we freeze the press deck. :thumbsup:

li_eng: If you run into ANY discrepancies, ping me directly and include the artifacts. We'll re-run an identical job and attach traces.

sara_marketing: Will do. Thanks all! :rocket:
